business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Commodity Trade in Whole and Skimmed Milk Powder

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu — International Company (IC) regime under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Customary Law with a statutory offshore corporate overlay under the International Companies Act)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2019, in force 2020)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus, signed 2017, in force 2020)
No comprehensive income tax DTA network; the International Company regime is statutorily tax-exempt, rendering tax-treaty reliance inapplicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended by the 2016–2019 AML/CFT reform package; Companies Act [Cap. 191] as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2016 as amended by Act No. 11 of 2017; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations (2017); VFSC AML/CFT Rules (2017); United Nations Financial Sanctions legislation implementing UN Security Council Resolutions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of each Beneficial Owner's valid passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the Beneficial Owner's country of citizenship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the issuing state; consular legalization only where the issuing state is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Undertaking (Form BOD-1) sworn before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution and the VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the notary's jurisdiction; consular legalization for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and proof of funding source covering the latest six months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Banking institution maintaining the Beneficial Owner's / Director's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct verification by the registered agent under VFSC AML/CFT Rules; notarization and apostille required only if the letter is to be relied upon as a certified exhibit in the Vanuatu registration file

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and certified corporate extract of any intermediary corporate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the intermediary entity's place of incorporation (e.g., Companies Registry of Hong Kong, New Zealand Companies Office, BVI Registry of Corporate Affairs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the source registry's supervising ministry or designated competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Due Diligence Questionnaire (CDD Form) and PEP/sanctions self-certification executed by each UBO, Director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant and Beneficial Owners executed before the VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal compliance file, not apostilled; retained at the registered office for 5 years under the AML/CFT Act

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all Beneficial Owners, Directors, and authorized representatives against the UN Security Council Consolidated List (Resolutions 1267/1988/1373), the Vanuatu national financial sanctions list, the OFAC SDN List (mandatory for USD-denominated LC/TT payment rails), the EU consolidated sanctions list, and the UK consolidated list. Mandatory enhanced due diligence (EDD) applies to all foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates pursuant to section 22 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 21 of 2016, and to all natural-person beneficial owners holding 25% or more of the International Company. Adverse-media screening, ongoing transaction monitoring, source-of-wealth verification, and a 5-year record-retention obligation apply throughout the corporate life.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Online International Company Registration and Name Search e-Registry System (available through https://www.vfsc.vu/)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names may be registered in English, French, or Bislama, but must be rendered entirely in Latin script. Any name derived from a non-Latin alphabet must be submitted with an official romanized transliteration, and the transliterated form must not be confusingly similar to any existing registered name. The name must not consist solely of a translated, phonetic, or graphically similar variant of a name already on the VFSC register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any token creating a false connection to the VFSC, the Republic of Vanuatu, or another state's regulator
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon VFSC name rejection, the applicant (through its VFSC-licensed registered agent) has 14 calendar days to file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar stating the proposed name, the registry file reference, and substantive legal and commercial grounds, together with a revised compliant name proposal. The VFSC registry appeals panel issues a written determination within 10 business days. If refused, the applicant may either re-file with a materially distinct name (new statutory search fee applies) or seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the general administrative law remedies within 30 days of final refusal. An approved name that is not used within the 30-day reservation window may be extended for one further 30-day period upon timely application and payment of the extension tariff, provided the name remains available; a lapsed rejection is not re-filed within 6 months absent express regulatory consent.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office. An International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of its VFSC-licensed registered agent, as mandated by section 28 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. A PO Box or virtual-only address is not acceptable as the statutory seat. Nonetheless, the substantive trading back-office, treasury functions, and sales operations of the dairy commodity business may be lawfully outsourced abroad as an accepted offshore-commercial-substance model; the Vanuatu nexus is satisfied by the licensed agent, registered office, and statutory record-keeping at the agent's physical premises.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate baseline risk: approximately 8% probability per VFSC supervisory cycle for a low-risk ISIC 4633 dairy commodity trading International Company with clean CDD and no adverse media. The probability escalates to 25–35% if the registered agent files risk-flagged UBO profiles, sanctions-list or PEP hits, or unusual transaction patterns. The VFSC retains statutory authority to conduct unannounced physical on-site inspections and to require production of books and records at the registered office under the AML/CFT Rules.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of approximately VT 3,000 under the VFSC Fees Regulations
Statutory tariff of approximately VT 32,000 under the Companies and International Companies Fees Regulations
Nil — expressly exempt under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 550–750 per annum for licensed agents providing statutory registered office, company secretarial services, and AML/CFT compliance file custody

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO piercing, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and AML/CFT CDD file compilation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel and the registered agent's compliance desk
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee benchmark of 4–6 hours at USD 70–100 per hour for low-risk commodity-trading entity due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille or consular legalization of UBO passport, Form BOD-1 declaration, and intermediary corporate good-standing extracts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and the competent apostille authority of the source state (e.g., Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate of USD 35–60 per document for apostille certification plus notarial fees at the place of execution

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial KYC and sanctions database screening license, per-entity pass-through
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed data vendor (e.g., LSEG World-Check, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance) through the registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Vendor standard per-entity screening fee for continuous monitoring over the first annual cycle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Intermediary corporate UBO certificate of good standing and corporate registry extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign corporate registry of the intermediary UBO's place of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry search, extract, and certificate fee of the source jurisdiction, including expedited processing where required

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222), Sections 4, 5, 9, 12, 15 and 23 (Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles, Registered Office, Officers); Companies (International) Regulations 2008
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Company Constitution) filed as Form IC-1 with VFSC
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; at least one share of no par value must be allotted. No escrow account requirement for International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the Company subscribe for one (1) fully paid share of no par value in the capital of the Company for the subscriber named in the Constitution, such share to be accepted and entered in the register of members; (2) the registered office of the Company be and is hereby established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, in accordance with Section 12 of the International Companies Act 1992; (3) the following persons be and are hereby appointed as first directors and officers: [Name] as Director, [Name] as Secretary, such appointments to take effect immediately; and (4) the Chairperson and any director be and are hereby authorized to execute and file all documents necessary to give effect to these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry, online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application via the VFSC online filing system with two alternative names. Ensure the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing regulated entity or protected word. Receive reservation confirmation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of a proposed name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity or prohibited words, file an appeal with VFSC within 14 days, or amend the proposed name and resubmit; no additional fee for resubmission if filed within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (approved by VFSC) or Vanuatu notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent to draft the Company's Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, incorporating mandatory clauses under Section 9. Execute and have the document notarized, if required by the registered agent's policy.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution)
Subscriber information and consent (natural persons or corporate shareholders)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registered agent queries any clause, revise the offending provision to comply with the International Companies Act and resubmit for execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Registry, Port Vila (physical submission or online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application with VFSC, attaching the executed Constitution and the notarized consent of the registered agent. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 250 plus any applicable expedited fee. Request concurrent issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as registered agent (Form RAG-1)
Consent to act as first director and secretary
Statutory declaration of compliance by subscriber or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to missing information or incomplete Annexure, file an amendment within 10 business days; VFSC will issue a formal query notice. Cure by submitting the requested documents and a cover letter through the registered agent; statutory fee refund, minus administrative charge, if application is withdrawn.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue certificate and submit post-incorporation details
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and the Company's registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the Company becomes a legal entity. The registered agent shall file a notice of registered office and the list of first directors and secretary with VFSC within the statutory period. Issue share certificates to subscribers on the date of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Notice of directors and secretary (Form D-1)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC rejects the post-incorporation notices for defects, re-file corrected forms within 5 business days; no penalty if cured within the first month. If any officer is unqualified, substitute with a qualifying person and notify VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate bank account and activate trade operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed bank, insurance, or financial institution in Vanuatu (or recognized external bank) and VFSC for ongoing compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Provide the Certificate of Incorporation, Constitution, letter of good standing, and director identification to the chosen financial institution. Execute a resolution of the board approving the opening of bank accounts and appointment of authorized signatories for wire transfers and documentary credits.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registered Agent and Registered Office
Certified passport copies and proof of address for directors and beneficial owners
Bank account opening forms and resolution of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional due diligence (e.g., source of funds for dairy commodity trade), provide a business plan, trade contracts, and supplier invoices. If the account is refused, select an alternative licensed bank or engage a foreign bank branch in Vanuatu.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives, Vanuatu
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Trading License for Dairy Commodities (Import/Export Wholesale) – Class B

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (trading-only, no physical processing, no discharge from site)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: As a non-processing trading entity, no wastewater discharge, VOC, or dust emissions are generated. If warehousing is involved, comply with VEPA waste storage guidelines, including spill containment and food-safe packaging disposal. Maintain supplier certificates of compliance with Codex Alimentarius for milk powder hygiene.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate for any rented office/warehouse (if physical storage in Vanuatu), structural load inspection for storage racks (if applicable), and a workplace health and safety clearance for any local employees under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2018. For a pure cross-border trading company without local staff, a registered agent's office certificate suffices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Department of Finance and Treasury, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; online portal: https://www.gov.vu and https://www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, so foreign entities are not issued a general taxpayer identification number. A VAT-registered business obtains a unique VAT registration number from VRC by filing the prescribed VAT registration application with incorporation documents, director identification, and local contact details when applicable. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is exempt from all national taxes and does not ordinarily obtain a VAT ID; it evidences its tax identity through the Certificate of Incorporation, IC status certificate, and exemption certificate issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or entity reclassification elections exist under Vanuatu law. An International Company may, by special resolution and VFSC approval, continue as an ordinary company under the Companies Act [Cap 191], which would remove the automatic tax-exemption status but would not create corporate income tax liability. Hybrid mismatch elections are inapplicable due to the absence of income tax; export zero-rating is applied mechanically under the VAT Act and cannot be elected or optimized.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 247]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: A supplier must register for VAT when taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceed or are likely to exceed VT 4,000,000 (four million vatu) in any consecutive 12-month period; registration is voluntary below this threshold. Supplies by an International Company that are made outside Vanuatu, or that are exported, are outside the scope or zero-rated and therefore do not create a VAT registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently mandate real-time electronic invoicing, continuous transaction control, digital stamping, or API-based fiscal clearance. Invoices must contain prescribed VAT content, be serially numbered, and be filed/retained for audit. Export transactions must be supported by customs declarations, commercial export invoices, transport documents, and, where applicable, inward remittance evidence; no fiscal e-invoicing clearance is in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Vanuatu are zero-rated where the goods are physically removed from Vanuatu within the time limit prescribed under the VAT Act and the supplier retains documentary evidence. Services supplied to non-residents are zero-rated if the services are not used or enjoyed in Vanuatu and are supplied for consideration to a recipient outside Vanuatu. For whole and skimmed milk powder traded as a cross-border commodity, supplies that never enter Vanuatu are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT; if goods are exported through Vanuatu or supplied and shipped from a Vanuatu bonded warehouse to a foreign buyer, the supply qualifies for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Vanuatu Customs Export Declaration (outward clearance form)
Bill of Lading or airway bill evidencing physical export from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice and packing list describing the milk powder commodity
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing export proceeds
Certificate of Origin (where required for preferential tariff purposes)
VAT zero-rating substantiation schedule retained for audit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Vanuatu Revenue and Customs may audit zero-rated export claims and require documentary proof of export and foreign payment. An unsupported or fraudulent zero-rating claim is treated as a taxable supply, triggering a clawback of 12.5% VAT with late-payment penalties and interest; deliberate evasion attracts criminal prosecution and director/personal liability under the VAT Act and Customs offences legislation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - central bank and exchange control administrator under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act and the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 68]
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu applies a liberal exchange-control regime to non-resident International Companies. Current-account convertibility for trade in whole and skimmed milk powder is unrestricted; capital-account contributions from shareholders may be received without RBV prior approval. The vatu (VUV) is convertible onshore but is not a deliverable offshore currency, therefore settlement is normally effected in USD/AUD/EUR through authorized dealers. Profit remittance is not subject to Vanuatu withholding tax or an exchange-control permit; the only practical hurdle is the receiving bank's source-of-funds verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender, conversion ratio, or statutory timeline applies to export proceeds received by a Vanuatu International Company. The Exchange Control Act only requires that export proceeds be collected through an authorized dealer, that the full invoice value be received within agreed commercial terms, and that the exporter retain the sales contract, commercial invoice, and transport document for exchange-control inspection. Proceeds may be held indefinitely in foreign currency; no VUV conversion quota is triggered.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Multi-Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Foreign-Currency Account
Resident Entity Operational Account (less suited to IC structure)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Offshore fintech and electronic-money institutions are not licensed by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu and cannot provide VUV-denominated accounts or documentary/LC services to a Vanuatu International Company. Such EMIs may support ancillary low-value USD/EUR remittances, but they are legally restricted from taking deposits as part of Vanuatu banking business and are unsuitable as primary clearing rails for dairy trade settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners must complete a live identity/AML interview; this may be done physically at the bank in Port Vila or, where the bank permits, by a secure video conference with an approved registered-agent attestation. Fully remote opening without any personal appearance or video call is generally not permitted for first-time International Companies; certified passports, notarized board resolutions, and source-of-wealth statements are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity of the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation and extract, registered-agent letter, register of members/directors, passport copies of all natural persons, shareholder chain diagram, and corporate resolution authorizing banking signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for inbound capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements or six-month bank statements of each remitting shareholder, share subscription agreement, board resolution to contribute capital, supporting disposition or loan documentation, and tax-residence certificate of the beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade documentation mismatch in dairy commodity flow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed purchase orders and master supply agreement, warehouse receipts, FAO/Codex quality certificates, bills of lading or airway bills, customs declarations, commercial invoice in export value, and matching LC/MT700 set.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure, adverse media, or shell-risk perception
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions/PEP screen, negative-news search, certificate of good standing from VFSC, IC statutory tax-exemption certificate, registered-agent attestation, and a legal opinion confirming actual treasury operations and non-shell character.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use only SWIFT MT103 transfers from the shareholder's own account in the same bank or another regulated bank, referencing 'Capital Contribution - VU_IC / ISIC 4633 dairy trading'. Include BPM6 economic category 'Direct investment equity capital' and the IC's registered agent details in the beneficiary address line. The receiving bank must hold a board resolution and source-of-funds letter before credit; no RBV exchange-control approval is required for non-resident IC capital inflows. Cash or non-banking transfer channels are prohibited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For open-account commodity payments use SWIFT MT103; for documentary trade use irrevocable confirmed letters of credit (MT700) and documentary collections (MT400/MT754). Settlement flows must be routed through the bank's correspondent network in USD (Fedwire/CHIPS), EUR (TARGET2), or AUD (RITS), with invoice numbers, milk-powder HS code 0402, and supporting transport documents attached to the transaction message to avoid payment screening. All outbound disbursements must be supported by the underlying sale/purchase contract and source-of-goods evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable foreign-exchange forwards in USD/AUD/EUR covering genuine dairy trade receivables/payables with an RBV-licensed authorized dealer
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in VUV/USD or VUV/AUD executed offshore against a hedged balance-sheet or contractual exposure of the IC
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD/EUR/AUD for financing and trade-credit rebalancing, subject to supporting committed trade-flow documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Renewal Fee and Registered Agent Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; renewal window opens 30 days before the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and forfeiture of assets to the Republic of Vanuatu.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-resident International Company under the International Companies Act; an audit is required only if the company elects to become a VFSC-licensed entity or is otherwise carrying on regulated financial activity, which is not applicable to ISIC 4633 wholesale milk powder trading.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies; internal records may be kept under IFRS or simplified cash-basis accounting, and books may be maintained outside Vanuatu.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Companies Act does not require an annual UBO declaration or UBO annual confirmation to be filed with VFSC. The registered agent must maintain the current register of members and register of directors at the registered office. Upon any share transfer, the instrument of transfer and updated share certificates must be submitted to the registered agent for prompt amendment of the register within 30 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; voluntary audit engagement typically ranges USD 800–USD 1,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) are wholly exempt from Vanuatu corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding taxes and stamp duties. There is no payroll tax or social security levy on non-resident directors and employees engaged outside Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required under Vanuatu law. ICs must file an Annual Return with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent on the VFSC online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return must be filed within 30 days after the anniversary of the IC's incorporation, and the annual renewal fee is payable before the start of each registration year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the registered agent that the Company is an International Company in good standing and that all required information has been supplied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident sole shareholder/director instructs the licensed agent; no personal tax return is accepted or processed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule B – Registered Office and Director Particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current registered office address and names of directors; a director may be an individual or body corporate of any nationality.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide certified copies of passports and proof of residence; the VFSC does not assess tax liability on these details.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule C – Share Register and Compliance Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholder names and a declaration that the company did not derive income from a source within Vanuatu during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No tax computation is attached because an IC is statutorily exempt from CIT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Return attracts a VFSC penalty of up to VUV 50,000; continued non-compliance leads to striking-off, de-registration and a cumulative restoration fee. Directors may be disqualified and personal liability can arise for unremitted statutory license fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu does not impose a domestic withholding tax on dividends and maintains no active comprehensive double taxation agreement network. For payments outbound from Vanuatu to a non-resident shareholder, no TRC from Vanuatu tax authorities is required. A Foreign Tax Credit claim in the recipient's home jurisdiction is handled separately under that jurisdiction's tax law; Vanuatu will not issue a tax residence certificate for ICs because they are not tax resident for comprehensive treaty purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties payable by an IC to a non-resident: statutory rate 0%, treaty rate 0% (no DTA applicable). Arm's length interest payable to a non-resident lender: statutory rate 0%, treaty rate 0%; any 'grossing-up' clauses should be validated for commercial reasons to avoid thin-capitalisation challenge in the lender's jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None. Vanuatu has no statutory transfer pricing regime for International Companies and no local currency threshold for Local File / Master File preparation. However, a dairy commodity trader holding a VFSC broker or dealer licence may be required to maintain contemporaneous pricing records to demonstrate arm's length revenue under AML/CFT fit-and-proper requirements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's ESR framework applies to International Companies carrying on specified 'relevant activities', including distribution and service centre activities. Pure wholesale trading of raw milk powder under ISIC 4633 may trigger 'distribution' substance requirements if the company derives income from purchasing goods from related parties and reselling to third parties outside Vanuatu. The IC must then demonstrate CIGA (directed and managed in Vanuatu), physical office presence, full-time staff and core income-generating activities in Vanuatu, or risk penalty of VUV 20,000 plus cancellation of the company's exemption status. Given the dairy commodity model, substance is recommended at the level of the operating distribution subsidiary and not the non-resident IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting actual management of a Vanuatu IC from a high-tax jurisdiction, claiming Vanuatu residence for tax avoidance while all active decision-making occurs abroad, or using the IC to conceal taxable trading profits of a related operating company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu International Companies Act and the penal code, penalties reach VUV 1,000,000 and compulsory de-registration. The IC loses its tax-exempt status retrospectively, and the entire income is treated as taxable in the beneficial owner's country of tax residence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution for unreported profit amounts, travel bans under mutual assistance orders, and up to 7 years' imprisonment for fraudulent false statements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Vanuatu IC with no physical presence, no director meetings in Vanuatu, no staff and no substance while booking cross-border milk powder sales and procurement through the IC solely to obtain zero-tax treatment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations, failure to meet the substance test triggers a penalty of VUV 20,000, a daily default penalty of VUV 500, and possible automatic cancellation of the IC's certificate of incorporation. The VFSC also has power to strike the company off for failure to demonstrate substance within a remedial period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for unpaid penalty amounts; the court may order disqualification of the director from acting as a director in Vanuatu for up to 5 years and may impose a travel restriction where the director attempts to leave Vanuatu while penalties are outstanding.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a registered office record of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) of the milk powder trading entity, or failing to submit the required beneficial ownership return; alternatively routing payments through non-Vanuatu shell payables with no commercial rationale in connection with the dairy commodity trade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu International Companies (Amendment) Act and the Anti-Money Laundering Act, fines of up to VUV 100,000 apply to the company and VUV 50,000 per director; funds and assets may be frozen under orders of the Vanuatu Supreme Court.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly fail to comply with UBO disclosure orders face civil liability for the full value of any funds laundered, exclusion from the dairy trading sector under VFSC industry directives, and imprisonment for up to 10 years for wilful money laundering.
